segments.name: Light Vehicle Drive Systems (Light Vehicle)
segments.description: Supplies drive and electrification systems to light vehicle OEMs for light trucks, SUVs, CUVs, vans, sports cars and passenger cars.
segments.evidence: We have aligned our organization around two operating segments: Light Vehicle Drive Systems (Light Vehicle) and Commercial Vehicle Drive and Motion Systems (Commercial Vehicle).

segments.name: Commercial Vehicle Drive and Motion Systems (Commercial Vehicle)
segments.description: Supplies drive and motion systems to commercial vehicle OEMs for medium and heavy duty trucks, buses and specialty vehicles.
segments.evidence: Our Commercial Vehicle segment supported the OEMs of on-highway commercial vehicles (primarily trucks and buses), while our Off-Highway segment supported OEMs of off-highway vehicles.

revenueModel.text: On-highway vehicle OEMs pay Dana for power-conveyance and energy-management products supplied under new business programs awarded in advance of program launches.
revenueModel.evidence: A substantial amount of the new business we are awarded by OEMs is granted well in advance of a program launch.

changes.text: In the first quarter of 2025, the Power Technologies segment was integrated into the Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle segments.
changes.evidence: In the first quarter of 2025, our Power Technologies segment was integrated into our Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle segments, streamlining the business, enhancing our go-to-market approach and serving our customers more efficiently.
